characterList.description: A large, muscular soldier wearing a dark green military uniform, a helmet, and a black mask. He is heavily wounded and appears to be in pain. He has a deep, gruff voice.
characterList.name: Heavy Soldier

characterList.description: A bald, scarred man with a goatee. He wears a brown jacket and has dark, piercing eyes. He speaks with a calm, measured tone.
characterList.name: Narrator

characterList.description: A muscular, red-haired character with cybernetic enhancements and sharp teeth. He wears a red and black outfit, a cap, sunglasses, and smokes a cigar.
characterList.name: Red Wolf
